item.title: MaiaSpace hot-fire test marks milestone for reusable launcher
item.description: The upper stage engine of MaiaSpace's reusable launcher completed its first hot-fire test, a milestone for the ArianeGroup subsidiary.
item.content:encoded:
The upper stage engine of MaiaSpace's reusable launcher completed its first hot-fire test, a milestone for the ArianeGroup subsidiary.

MaiaSpace targets a first flight later in the decade.
